h1: How do setbacks work on a corner lot in Newton, MA?
title: Newton Corner Lot Setbacks: Front Yards and Property Boundaries
description: Learn why a corner lot needs property-specific zoning review before choosing which side is the front, side, or rear yard.
short_answer: A corner lot can have different setback consequences from an interior lot because it borders two streets. Newton's zoning ordinance contains a specific definition of a corner lot and separate dimensional standards for lot boundaries. Do not assume one street-facing side is automatically treated as a side yard; confirm the parcel's zoning interpretation with Planning.

facts.text: Newton's zoning ordinance defines a corner lot separately from an interior lot and uses that definition when applying zoning requirements.
The applicable front, side, and rear setbacks must be determined from the parcel's zoning district and the ordinance provisions that apply to its lot boundaries.

qa.q: Does every corner lot have two front setbacks?
qa.a: The exact classification and setback treatment should be confirmed from the current zoning ordinance and parcel map. The sources reviewed do not support one universal answer for every corner lot.
